text: The draft settles an issue's coding agent (#173). Every drafted proposal carries the agent its issue's Agent: line picked, and every build of it, a retry's included, runs the agent the ratified proposal settles: that line's, else its project's manifest's as ratified, else the watcher's own. The build never reads the issue again. Otherwise anyone who can edit an issue, a writer or not, could change which agent builds it after it's ratified, and a new project's manifest could name an agent that didn't build it, as #176's review found. Only a writer's revise, which drafts the issue again, changes its agent.
